name: Mutable Dreams
author: Kid Bunka
tagline: Living sound worlds for the M-VAVE FM-1
description: An open-source six-track FM-1 instrument with 275 musical Biomes plus Blank, 640 Tones, 24 sound models, Live List, dream performance macros, sequencing, effects and per-track generated USB MIDI notes.

flash_status.B36014: offline checked; exact-build hardware validation pending

credits: Created by Kid Bunka; inspired by the open source work of Mutable Instruments, built with fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Independent from Mutable Instruments and M-VAVE.
